notes: VERIFICATION NOTE (per coordinator's instruction): an external claim that Everton is worth 'about $850M-1.0B, Friedkin acquisition' does NOT match the original reporting located. The actual reporting (Mark Douglas/The i Paper, via goodisonnews.com, published September 2026) states the Friedkin Group values Everton at approximately GBP1 billion (~$1,270m at ~1.27 GBP/USD) - notably higher than the external claim, and citing West Ham's rejected GBP800m bid for the club (when West Ham were still in the Premier League) as a reference point. Crucially, this is NOT a completed transaction or an independent valuation - it is the Friedkins' own internal figure, used as the pricing basis for a still-pending MINORITY stake sale, so it should be treated as a related party's self-interested number, not a market-clearing price. The Friedkin Group's original 2024 Everton acquisition price (~GBP400-500m reported at the time) is a separate, lower, and more independently-verified figure not used here.
